subject: Staged renewal governance & billing handshake
messages:
From: Alex Torres <procurement@acmedata.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jae Park <finance@acmedata.com>, Acme Data Legal <legal@acmedata.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal options — need to align billing window and ramp

Dylan,

Thanks for sending the renewal packet earlier this week. We reviewed the proposed multi-year layout and have a couple of operational asks before legal will sign: 

1) Can you split the first-year commitment into two tranches (Q1 onramp 60%, Q3 top-up 40%)? That helps our finance team smooth cashflow.
2) We need CO-TERM alignment with our other vendor contracts (Oct 31 fiscal boundary).
3) Billing frequency: we prefer quarterly invoices rather than annual invoices for this agreement.

Attached is a short summary from our side (renewal_summary_v1.pdf). Can your team confirm whether Redwood can: a) produce a staggered invoice schedule, b) set an auto-renew opt-out window, and c) provide a one-time credit if usage exceeds the 120% threshold in month three?

Best,
Alex Torres
Head of Procurement, Acme Data
procurement@acmedata.com

--
Attachment: renewal_summary_v1.pdf (1 page summary)
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <procurement@acmedata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal options — need to align billing window and ramp

Alex — thanks for the quick review and the helpful summary. Short answer: yes on staged onramp and quarterly billing; we can also include an auto-renew opt-out window. A few clarifying points so we can update the SOW the right way: 

- Staged commitment: we can split year 1 into the 60% / 40% tranches you proposed. We will map the second tranche to the July billing cycle (Q3) as you asked.
- Co-term: we can co-term to Oct 31 but will need to prorate the first partial year to reflect the shortened initial cycle.
- Credit on overage: instead of an unconditional credit, we propose a staged protection band — if monthly usage exceeds 120% for two consecutive months, a one-time credit equal to 15% of the overage token cost will apply. This prevents one-off spikes from triggering credits.

I'm looping in Marissa and Kim to handle the legal/billing language and to draft the SOW. We can run a quick 20-min call to confirm operational cutover and invoice cadence tomorrow at 10am PT if that works.

Next steps (proposed):
- Marissa: draft SOW with staged tranches + prorate language
- Kim: prepare invoice cadence example and outline amendment wording for auto-renew opt-out window
- Alex: confirm the July target date for tranche 2 and whether Acme needs a PO for Q1 invoice

Thanks — appreciate the partnership on this.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0187

--
Attachment: (none)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Alex Torres <procurement@acmedata.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 11:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft SOW + proposed amendment language

Alex / team — attaching a working draft of the SOW that implements Dylan's notes. Key clauses to review: 

- Section 1.2 (Commitment Schedule): explicit tranche amounts and effective dates; we included the proration example to show how the partial first year will be billed.
- Section 3.4 (Overage Protection): the staged protection band language (2-month consecutive exceedance -> 15% credit) is included.
- Section 6.1 (Auto-Renew & Opt-Out): 60-day opt-out window prior to renewal; we can shorten to 30 days if your procurement team prefers.
- Billing Schedule appendix: sample invoices for Q1 (prorated), Q2, Q3 (tranche top-up), Q4.

Please review the attached SOW (SOW-redwood-acme-draft.docx) and the in-email bullet summary below. We're flexible on the opt-out window and the credit percentage — flag what you need and we'll iterate.

Bullets for review:
- Proration calculation: prorate on a daily basis to Oct 31 co-term.
- Invoices: Redwood will issue quarterly invoices in net-30 terms, with separate line items for tranche billing.
- PO requirement: if Acme requires a PO to process the Q1 invoice, provide PO number before July 5 cutover.

If it helps, Camila can run the billing examples in our sandbox and produce a mock invoice set by Friday.

Marissa Cole
Senior Commercial Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: SOW-redwood-acme-draft.docx (Draft SOW, 6 pages)
From: Jae Park <finance@acmedata.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Torres <procurement@acmedata.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Jul 2026 08:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft SOW + proposed amendment language

Marissa — thanks for the draft. A couple finance notes: 

1) We can accept net-30 quarterly invoicing. Please send the Q1 prorated invoice separately from the tranche top-up invoice so our AP system can code costs to the correct fiscal buckets.
2) The 60-day opt-out is fine; prefer to keep 60 days.
3) PO: we'll issue a PO for Q1 if we get a final SOW and an invoice request by July 6.

Also, can you confirm whether Redwood will provide a one-time invoice credit or an accrual entry? For our auditors, a direct invoice credit is cleaner.

Thanks,
Jae Park
Director of Finance, Acme Data
finance@acmedata.com
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <procurement@acmedata.com>, Jae Park <finance@acmedata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft SOW + proposed amendment language

Alex / Jae — quick update and final ask before sending to legal: 

- Marissa updated the SOW per Jae's note; we will issue the credit as a direct invoice credit applied to the following invoice (not an accrual). Language is in Section 3.4 and the Billing Appendix.
- Camila will generate the mock invoice set and sample proration calculations and send to your AP inbox by EOD Monday.
- For co-terming to Oct 31: Redwood will close the first (partial) year on Oct 31 and prorate as shown in the appendix; subsequent years will be Oct 31–Oct 30 cycles.

Final ask: can Acme confirm the PO number for Q1 billing by July 14 and confirm that the July tranche top-up date (target: 2026-07-15) works operationally? If yes, we'll attach the final SOW and the DocuSign envelope tomorrow and route to your legal team.

Appreciate it — will keep this moving.

—Dylan
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0187

--
Attachment: mock_invoice_examples.xlsx (to follow from Camila)
